author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Use Gemini AI inside of Google Docs to write better documents, analyze information, and combine content. In this video, I’ll show three ways to work with Gemini inside of Google Docs, including the Gemini side panel directly in the Docs interface. Sources and context matter, so I’ll show how to control whether Gemini can access information from your Google Drive, email messages, or chats to draft or rewrite text in your documents. I’ll also discuss some use cases and give useful advice for using Gemini effectively and being more productive in Google Workspace.

What you’ll learn:
• Use the Gemini Panel in Google Docs
• Set sources to expand or focus information analysis
• Reference other documents or email messages to create new drafts
• Work with the Gemini Bottom Bar to draft new content or rewrite sections of a document
• Use AI tools in the Gemini Menu

Host: Nick Brazzi
